['EDEKA Zentrale AG & Co. KG '].company_description: EDEKA Zentrale AG & Co. KG is the largest German supermarket corporation, consisting of several co-operatives of independent supermarkets. It operates approximately 4,100 stores under the Edeka nameplate, ranging from small corner stores to hypermarkets. The company also acquired Tengelmann's Plus discounter store division, which was merged into Edeka's Netto brand. EDEKA Zentrale AG & Co. KG is headquartered in Hamburg and operates as the central financing institute for Edeka grocery retailers.

['Audi AG '].company_description: Audi AG is a German automotive manufacturer of luxury vehicles. It operates in the automotive industry and produces vehicles in nine production facilities worldwide. Audi is a subsidiary of the Volkswagen Group and is known for its luxury and high-performance vehicles. The company offers a range of models, including sedans, SUVs, coupes, and electric vehicles. Some notable models include the Audi A3, A4, A6, Q5, Q7, and the all-electric Audi e-tron. Audi is recognized for its advanced technology, innovative design, and the use of quattro all-wheel drive system in many of its vehicles.
